description.text: Learn about the security budgeting, people management, emergency coordination and risk decisions of Security Managers 11-3013.01, and the scope limits of the U.S. 11-3013 facilities manager statistics.

subject.name: Security Managers
subject.summary: Security managers (O*NET 11-3013.01) direct an organization's physical security and employee and facility security functions, planning budgets, people, systems, policies and emergency response, and are accountable for implementation results. U.S. wages and employment correspond to the 11-3013 facilities manager occupation and cannot be treated as standalone 11-3013.01 data.
